name: Raw Cashew Nut Sizing Machine
shortDescription: Cleans and sizes raw cashew nuts into five groups, A+, A, B, C, D, with up to 98% accuracy.
description: This machine cleans raw cashew nuts and sizes them by diameter at 28, 26, 24, 22, 20 and 18 mm, sorting them into groups A+, A, B, C and D. Evenly sized nuts reduce broken, uncut and off-centre cuts in the shelling machine. The octagonal (8-sided) grading drum is made of 4–6 mm MS steel, with each mesh section sized to the required capacity. Nuts are fed automatically through a hopper and PE bucket elevator, and inverters adjust the drum and feed-belt speed for sizing accuracy of up to 98%. The square-tube frame is CNC machined, with Japanese/German motors and Taiwanese/Japanese/Korean electrics, CE certified. The machine runs on its own or links with the cleaner, silos, steamer and cooling system into one automatic system, and suits both vertical and horizontal shelling machines.

name: Static Raw Cashew Steam Cooker
shortDescription: Autoclave-style pressure cooker that steams raw cashew nuts evenly, batch by batch.
description: The cooker uses pressurised saturated steam from the boiler to cook raw cashew nuts on the autoclave principle. Steaming loosens the kernel from the shell so the shelling machine cuts easily, with fewer broken and uncut nuts. The vessel is made of special cast steel with two layers and cotton insulation, with stainless 304 as an option. It has a temperature gauge, pressure safety valve and timer; nuts are fed by hopper and bucket elevator and discharged automatically. Cookers run singly or are combined into a high-capacity steaming system.

name: Rotary Drum Cashew Steamer
shortDescription: Rotating drum that tumbles raw cashew nuts in steam continuously for more even cooking.
description: The rotary steamer tumbles raw cashew nuts continuously in pressurised saturated steam from the boiler, so every nut receives the same heat and cooks more evenly than in a static cooker. Even cooking loosens the kernel from the shell so the shelling machine cuts easily, with fewer broken and uncut nuts. The body is made of special cast steel with two layers and cotton insulation, with stainless 304 as an option. It has a temperature gauge, pressure safety valve and timer; nuts are fed by hopper and bucket elevator and discharged automatically. Steamers run singly or are combined into a high-capacity steaming system.

name: Automatic Horizontal Cashew Shelling Machine
shortDescription: Horizontal sheller with 8–15 blades, under 5% broken and over 95% separation.
description: This machine feeds and cuts nuts with a horizontal drive (chain conveyor and feeding moulds), the most widely used shelling design on the market. Depending on the number of blades, from 8 to 15, it delivers 180–600 kg/h with under 5% broken and over 95% separation (over 99% on the 15-blade version). The frame, feeding moulds, guide bars and blade holders are CNC machined and robot welded. Feeding moulds are aluminium or PA plastic, blade holders are heat-treated cast steel, and the cutting and splitting blades are special alloy steel. It uses Bonfiglioli (Italy) gear motors, NTN/ASAHI (Japan) bearings and Siemens/Mitsubishi inverters, is CE certified, and connects easily to an automatic separating system.

name: Cashew Kernel Chamber Dryer (Borma)
shortDescription: Chamber dryer with reversing hot-air circulation, 1,000–5,800 kg of kernels per batch.
description: The dryer dries kernels with the testa still on, so the testa becomes dry, brittle and easy to peel in the next step. The frame, trolleys and trays are galvanised steel; the galvanised sheet walls carry 50 mm insulation at 80 kg/m³. Two heat exchangers (calorifiers) placed symmetrically on each side and four fans circulate hot air in alternating directions, saving heat and shortening drying time. Time, temperature and pressure are easy to set. Motors and electrics are imported from Europe or Japan.

name: Automatic Cashew Peeling Machine
shortDescription: Peels the testa with a rotating drum and compressed air, 80–90% whole white kernels in one pass.
description: Dried kernels enter a rotating drum with brush or spring rollers; friction between the drum and rollers cracks the testa, then high-pressure compressed air blows it away. The drum and spring rollers are angle-adjustable so kernels are not scratched, and the custom air-blow system saves compressed air. Each machine has dust extraction and a grading drum (W, LP, WS), and runs fully automatically from hopper and bucket elevator through the peeling drum and aerodynamic separation to the grading drum. It peels 80–90% of kernels clean in one pass with under 8% broken, without damaging kernels or oil contamination. The frame is stainless steel, with Japanese, Korean and Taiwanese motors and electrics (Schneider). It runs alone for 1–10 tonne/day workshops, or combines with colour sorters and graders into a system for 20–100 tonne/day plants.

name: Cashew Industrial Screw Air Compressor System
shortDescription: Heavy-duty rotary screw air compressor system supplying high-pressure dry air for cashew peeling lines.
description: Specially engineered for automated cashew processing factories, this heavy-duty rotary screw air compressor system supplies clean, oil-controlled, high-pressure compressed air to drive continuous peeling lines. The complete system integrates a high-efficiency twin-screw host (European rotor technology), a Siemens high-efficiency motor (IP54/IP55 class F), a heavy-duty oil-gas separator cylinder (maintaining oil carryover below 2–3 PPM), an independent oil cooler, and a refrigerated air dryer. Designed for 24/7 continuous operation in high ambient temperatures, it powers pneumatic peeling machines for plant capacities ranging from 10 to 100 tonnes per day.

name: Whole Cashew Kernel Grading Machine
shortDescription: Grades whole kernels through the gap between two rollers into W240, W320, W450 and WS.
description: The machine grades kernels by the gap between two rollers: kernels drop through according to size and diameter, sorting into W240, W320, W450 and WS with about 90% accuracy. It works alongside colour sorters and operators to meet export market grade requirements. The frame is stainless 304 (or painted steel with stainless rollers), and the bearings, motors and electrics are CE certified. A central control cabinet offers manual and automatic modes; adjust the roller gap to change grade. The set includes hopper, bucket elevator and main machine.

name: Cashew Vacuum Packing Line
shortDescription: Final inspection and 10–35 kg vacuum bags, flushed with CO₂, N₂ or a gas mix.
description: The line runs a final inspection (vibrating sieve, dust extraction, X-ray, metal detection) and then packs cashew kernels into 10–35 kg vacuum bags (25 LB, 50 LB). Bags are vacuum sealed or flushed with CO₂, N₂ or a modified gas mix (MAP) to protect quality in storage and export shipping. The whole line is SUS304, with HACCP-compliant PE bucket elevators and a Busch (Germany) or Japanese vacuum pump. It has manual and automatic modes and suits plants of 10–100 tonnes per day.
